scope.section: Section 7 -- Building Thermal Envelope and Fabric Load

annex_b8_role: diagnostic context only -- NOT a criterion; Annex B8 states that its example-result statistics are not to be interpreted as acceptance criteria

unit_conversions.field: monthly hourly integrated peak heating and cooling loads

notes: Case states are conformant / incomplete / not implemented. No aggregate grade or pass/fail verdict is reported anywhere in these artifacts: the standard defines no such quantity.
Requirement cell states are report (required, produced), partial (required, produced for a subset), missing (required, not produced) and na (not required for this case).

The Annex B8 columns are the min/max spread of the six example results published in informative Annex B8. Annex B8 states verbatim that these statistics 'do not have any substantial importance and are not to be interpreted as acceptance criteria'. They are diagnostic context only, not a criterion.

Monthly loads are reported in kWh and monthly peak powers in kW, as Section 6.2.1.2.4 requires; the emitter's contract CSV carries them in MWh and W respectively, so the values are converted (x1000 and /1000) rather than re-derived.
A monthly or annual peak occurrence is left empty when the matching peak value is zero: the emitter writes a sentinel timestamp for months and cases without load, and a sentinel is not an occurrence.

Section 6.2.1.8 (Table 6-1) is held at 'partial' for every case that carries the requirement: the day cells of Table 6-1 in the in-repo copy of the standard carry unresolved tracked changes, so the required day list cannot be confirmed against a clean copy of the standard.

The Section 6.2.1.7.1 temperature-bin histogram is the emitter's 90-slot array: slot i counts the hours whose zone-air temperature floor falls in the 1 degC bin with lower bound (i - 19) degC, i.e. lower bounds -19..+70 degC, with hours below -19 degC clamped into the first bin. The standard words the range as '-20 degC to 70 degC' (the same 90 bins read with the -20 degC lower bound), so the coldest 1 degC band is reported one bin high.
Case 970 is a fluxion case with no 140-2017 definition; it is evaluated against the generic Section 6.2.1.1 output set only.
